# Steve Jobs first iPhone call to Jony Ive 2007

**Source**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uPd3P3UuGb8

**Transcribed**: 2025-12-26 13:07

---

**[Steve Jobs]**: I can just push here and I see Johnny Ives contacts with all his information, his three phone numbers, his email, whatever else, his address, whatever else I've got, it's all in one place.
And if I want to call Johnny, all I do is push his phone number.
I'll call his mobile number right now.
And now we are calling Johnny here.
I'm going to turn on the speakerphone like this if I wanted to.

**[Jony Ive]**: Hello, Steve.

**[Steve Jobs]**: Hey, Johnny, how you doing?

**[Jony Ive]**: I'm good.
How are you doing?

**[Steve Jobs]**: Well, it's been two and a half years and I I can't tell you how thrilled I am to make the first public phone call with iPhone.

Whoa, whoa, what is this?
I've got another call coming in.
Johnny, can I put you on hold for a minute?

**[Jony Ive]**: Yeah, sure.

**[Steve Jobs]**: Okay.
So I'll put Johnny on hold and hi, Phil.

**[Phil Schiller]**: Hi, Steve, I wanted to be the first call.

**[Steve Jobs]**: Sorry, Phil.
As you can see, it's put it's put Johnny on hold and Phil, I can just touch Johnny and bring Johnny back.
Hey, Johnny, you there?

**[Jony Ive]**: Yeah, I'm here.

**[Steve Jobs]**: Hey, listen, Phil called.
Do you mind if I uh conference him in?

**[Jony Ive]**: I I guess so.
You can see the button has changed to merge calls right there in the middle, so I just push that right here.
And now I've created a conference call.

Johnny, you there?

**[Jony Ive]**: I'm here.

**[Steve Jobs]**: Phil, you there?

**[Phil Schiller]**: I'm still hanging on.

**[Steve Jobs]**: So here we are.
And uh listen, I got to get back to my keynote.
So uh if I want to do that, what I'm I just touch this arrow right here and uh I'm going to go ahead and take Johnny private here and uh put Phil on hold.
Johnny, do you have anything to say on the first phone call?

**[Jony Ive]**: It's it's uh it's not too shabby, is it?

**[Steve Jobs]**: It's not too shabby.
You take care, Johnny.

**[Jony Ive]**: I'll see you later.

**[Steve Jobs]**: And I end this call and it Phil's on hold.
I take him off a hold.
Phil, thanks very much.
I got to get back to the keynote now.

**[Phil Schiller]**: All right, talk to you later.
